tools.name: search_docs
tools.description: Full-text search across Vector Panda concepts, tutorials, projects, and the engineering build log. Returns ranked matches with canonical URLs and freshness.

tools.name: read_doc
tools.description: Fetch the full Markdown of one document by its site path (for example /docs/concepts/embeddings-101), as returned by search_docs.

tools.name: get_quickstart
tools.description: The Vector Panda quickstart: install the veep Python SDK, upload a file, and run similarity queries end to end.

tools.name: get_api_operation
tools.description: List public REST API operations, or pass one (e.g. "POST /api/v1/query") for its parameters, request body, responses, and auth. Sourced from the published OpenAPI spec.

tools.name: get_pricing
tools.description: Current storage-tier pricing, monthly usage credits, and billing cycle. Storage-only pricing: no per-query or egress fees.

tools.name: get_benchmark_methodology
tools.description: Measured benchmark results and full reproduction methodology (VectorDBBench through the public API), including dataset, recall, and cost.

tools.name: compare_storage_tiers
tools.description: Hot, warm, and paused storage tiers: current per-GB prices with what each tier means for query latency and when to pick it.

tools.name: list_supported_formats
tools.description: File formats accepted for vector ingestion, from the canonical features page.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: search_docs, get_api_operation · Private data: read_doc, get_quickstart, list_supported_formats · Public sink: get_quickstart, get_api_operation · Destructive: get_quickstart.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: search_docs, get_api_operation · Private data: read_doc, get_quickstart, list_supported_formats · Public sink: get_quickstart, get_api_operation · Destructive: get_quickstart

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
